title: cassia javanica subsp. bartonii
intro: Cassia javanica subsp. bartonii, commonly known as East Indian cassia, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of East Indian cassia include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and fight infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties.
